messages:
lin: FYI EU GPU warm-pool failing after we flipped audit routing to auditfold at 09:05. joins timing out.
marie: seeing keystore-proxy backlog + natgw conntrack spike. attaching logs. :eyes:
ranjit: auditfold added strict auth header check; proxy retries on 401s. that creates bursts.
lin: yes, retry storms push conntrack to 65k -> node NATGW refuses new sockets -> gpu join timeout.
sre-bot: Alert: keystore-proxy p95>2s EU (09:07).
marie: mitigation: rollback auditfold routing, and as temporary measure add egress allowlist for auditfold to bypass proxy.
lin: rollback started. will patch allowlist only if rollbacks don't stabilize warmup.
ops-runbook-bot: Incident INFRA-2026-03-23-02 created, assigned to infra-oncall. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-retrystorm
ranjit: follow-ups: canary rollout 1%, IAM boundary on audit principal, implement circuit-breaker in keystore-proxy to cap retry bursts.
lin: filing ticket INFRA-8480 for canary + CB. keeping auditfold disabled in EU until validated.
marie: agree. also track conntrack delta and egress billing impact.
